people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: However Yahweh would not destroy Judah, for David his servant’s sake, as he promised him to give to him a lamp for his children always.
translations.bsb: Yet for the sake of His servant David, the LORD was unwilling to destroy Judah, since He had promised to maintain a lamp for David and his descendants forever.
translations.kjv: Yet the LORD would not destroy Judah for David his servant's sake, as he promised him to give him alway a light, and to his children.
translations.asv: Howbeit Jehovah would not destroy Judah, for David his servant's sake, as he promised him to give unto him a lamp for his children alway.
